items.html: *We shall explain the matter of the thirteen corrections of the beard that issue from the third head, called the Mocha, the hidden Hochma, as above. And there it was explained that the seven lower [Sefirot] of Atik Yomin also became clothed in them, just as they became clothed in the seven corrections of the head, which are also divided into thirteen, as mentioned there. And I did not receive their order. And you must know that the matter of these thirteen corrections of the beard — all of them are strong judgments, and they are made from the clarifications of the kings, from that which was clarified from them and became the aspect of these thirteen corrections. Therefore these thirteen corrections did not issue except from the hidden Mocha, since all the clarifications were clarified in the thought (Machshava), as above. For the hidden Mocha, the Hochma of Arich Anpin, is female (Nukva) relative to the Keter, the skull of Arich Anpin; and therefore all these corrections of the beard were clarified within it, from the aspect of the kings.
